about: Hot Shots Golf™ originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
Go golf crazy and take on a cast of colorful characters in the coolest clubhouse around. Select a golfer from a range of friendly faces, and tee off for a round of Hot Shots Golf™.
Tackle some tough courses in game modes such as tournament and match play, then head to the green for the mini golf putting challenge.

This title has been converted from the PlayStation® version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PlayStation® version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PlayStation® console’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
summary: Hot Shots Golf™ originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
